item.title: 【HD Live Performances】BDRiP - BABYMETAL - LIVE AT THE O2 ARENA (1080p HD)
item.description:
BABYMETAL - LIVE AT THE O2 ARENA (1080p HD)​


​
This film captures BABYMETAL's performance at London's O2 Arena in May of this year. This legendary venue, which has seen top artists such as Led Zeppelin, Billie Eilish, and Lady Gaga perform, was the first time a Japanese group had ever performed there alone. All 20,000 tickets sold out in one day, making it a night that will go down in history. Celebrating their 15th anniversary since their formation, this must-see film lets you experience BABYMETAL's stunning live performance in the UK, the home of rock and metal, and the enthusiasm of their local British fans.
​


More information: https://www.asmart.jp/en/shop/babymetal/product/10048288

​
The m-flo 20th Anniversary Live 'KYO' was a special two-day concert series held on November 22-23, 2019, at Zepp Tokyo, celebrating the band’s 20th anniversary with original members LISA, VERBAL, and ☆Taku Takahashi. The show highlighted their 9th album KYO, blending nostalgic hits with the "m-flo loves" era featuring guests like Crystal Kay and MINMI.
